name.notes: Zepto uses hashed class names. Name is the first span whose text starts with a letter.

unit.notes: First span starting with a digit — e.g. '1 pack (500 ml)', '500 g'. Avoids review-count spans that were matched by last-span.

name.notes: Flipkart Minutes uses RNW-style class names. Product name is the longest alpha-starting text among all leaf elements.

price.notes: First ₹ element is the strikethrough MRP; last ₹ element is the discounted sale price.

unit.notes: First leaf element matching a weight/volume pattern e.g. '1 L', '500 g'.

name.notes: Swiggy uses hashed CSS-module classes. Product name is reliably in the product image alt attribute.

price.notes: Swiggy renders ₹ via CSS ::before — textContent is a plain number. First leaf element without aria-hidden containing a pure number is the current price.

unit.notes: First element (< 30 chars) whose textContent matches a weight/volume pattern, e.g. '500 ml', '1 kg'.

name.notes: Amazon uses stable h2+span for the product title — no class-name hashing.

price.notes: First .a-price-whole is the sale price as a plain integer (no ₹). parsePrice handles the conversion.

unit.notes: Unit is typically embedded in the product title (e.g. '1L', '500 g'). findUnitNear fallback extracts it from within the name span.
